profile.summary: A nonprofit that teaches resilience skills to young people through science-based media and programs. Its content helps youth understand their nervous systems, interrupt negative thought patterns and cope with stress and trauma. It began in 2011 with community work in San Francisco and became a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit in 2019.
